component: mbox repair module worker and test naming

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This family uses MboxRepair.sys.mjs for the privileged module and MboxRepair.worker.mjs for its worker, with lowerCamel repairMbox/mac2unix functions. The unit harness is test_repairMbox.js and its tasks name cases such as testStraddledCR. moz.build packages both resources and the IMAP test manifest registers the harness. Scoped naming recommendation: preserve this paired basename and resource suffix meaning instead of applying a dashed filename rule from DOM-element modules. This is static source and test-code inspection at the frozen accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remain pending; a landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: Mbox repair resource and test names preserve the module-worker relationship
